title: Q4: rim aggregation
prompt: Implement `rimSum`: the sum of border cells. Handle the degenerate shapes (1xN, Nx1 — every cell is border; 1x1 — the single cell) explicitly. This is a fencepost-style boundary test in grid form.

tests.name: rim totaled
tests.hint: Two options: sum everything minus interior, or iterate with r==0/last || c==0/last.
